description.purpose: `logicalType` is optional on a schema property. A contract that describes its columns with `physicalType` alone — the common shape when a schema is imported from DDL and the source type has no portable logical equivalent — must validate. description.purpose: RFC-0026a defines the `id` character rule as a denylist: an id cannot contain `.`, `#`, `/`, `\`, `@`, `!`, `%`, `&` or `^`. Everything else is legal, including `:`, which namespaced identifiers coming from a catalog or an ontology commonly use. Guards the regression fixed alongside this example, where the schema implemented a far narrower allowlist (`^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$`) and rejected every id and every fully qualified reference carrying a colon.
